runs.prompt: Change the STUSB4500QTR C2678061 NVM policy to request 15 V and prove the UMW AO3401A C347476 load switch remains safely off through dead-battery, reset, attach, hard reset, fault, and disconnect.

conditions: mirror-only STUSB trust; NVM/readback/as-built state absent
ideal VBEN-low divider gives VGS -6 V at 15 V, -8 V at 20 V, -12.96 V at conditioned 32.4 V TVS table point
nominal gate tau approximately 6 ms excluding device/parasitic/waveform effects
response.refusal: Safety proof cannot be established without as-built NVM readback, dynamic gate, parasitic and waveform evidence, reset and fault sequencing, and bench or simulation evidence; no design change is authorized.

runs.prompt: Evaluate G-Switch SS-12D01-G020 C5446803 low-profile Board L switch and isolated live OFF throw; prove OFF isolation, mounted height and capacitive switching endurance.

conditions: SW2 center common 2 receives V15_FUSED and joins outer pin 1 to switched V15 in ON. In OFF it joins isolated outer pin 3, which has no PCB net but is fused-feed live. Both converters lose normal supply in OFF while Board P remains powered. G020 has a 2 mm actuator and 5.5 mm body-plus-actuator dimension; the corrected model retains shoulder stand-off for approximately 6 mm PCB reach, requiring physical confirmation. Verify inrush, bounce, restart, contact life, rail decay and service-interface back-power. Exact switch drawing remains manufacturer-mirror evidence.
response.refusal: The design supports normal feed interruption through common 2 to pin 1 in ON, with pin 3 isolated on the PCB but live in OFF. It does not prove capacitive-switch endurance or absence of alternate back-power. The mirrored drawing provides 3.5 mm body plus 2 mm actuator, while the model retains about 0.5 mm shoulder stand-off; approximately 6 mm mounted reach needs physical verification. Production and bench certification are refused from this evidence alone.

runs.prompt: Evaluate ALPS RK10J11E0034 C470643 stopped brightness potentiometer with R27/R22/C22 and STM32 PA0 ADC; prove calibrated brightness, open-wiper behavior, safe startup and fit in the 1.6 mm board.

conditions: RV1 RK10J11E0034 is the single-unit 10 kOhm +/-30% stopped potentiometer: end 1=GND, end 3=V3P3, wiper 2 through R27 100 Ohm to U3.7 PA0 BRIGHT_ADC; all four mechanical pads and U3.8 are no-connects. R22 100 kOhm and C22 100 nF connect BRIGHT_ADC to GND. Worst divider source resistance is 3.25 kOhm plus 100 Ohm before bias loading; open-wiper nominal RC decay is 10 ms, not a certified fault detector. Use the documented 160.5-cycle ADC target, reference/errata review, endpoint and inversion calibration, averaging and startup ramp with thermal/PD gates. The 270-degree physical stops replace quadrature behavior. The catalog lists Insertion (t: 2 mm); this is not treated as a mandatory PCB thickness. Seating and contact life on the actual 1.6 mm PCB need prototype proof, and firmware is not flashed.
response.refusal: The single-gang wiper 2, endpoints 1 and 3, and four mechanical no-connects match the primary drawing. The nominal design calculations give 13000/4 + 100 = 3350 Ohm before bias and 100000 x 100 nF = 10 ms open-wiper decay; loading means the transfer is not perfectly linear. The static circuit does not prove calibrated brightness, safe flashed startup, detection of all wiper faults or seating in the actual 1.6 mm PCB; the catalog Insertion (t: 2 mm) notation does not prove that a 2 mm substrate is mandatory. Endpoint and inversion calibration, long ADC sampling, reference and errata review, and bench startup, gate and fit verification are required before certification.
